tagline: Finds the best coupon and bank offer at checkout
yourCodesHint: One code per line. Only codes you already have.
telemetryHint: Sends only: store, code, worked or not. No personal data.
noField: Couldn't find a promo-code box on this page. Open the payment/checkout step and try again.
captcha: The site is asking for a verification check. Stopped so you can finish it yourself.
noTotal: Couldn't read the payable total on this page.
noCodes: No codes to try for this store. Add your own codes in the popup.
bankHint: Estimated from the offer text. Pay with that card/method to get it; not applied by Promo-Flow.
noneWorked: No code worked on this cart.
unverifiedSite: This site's support is experimental. Check the final total before paying.
notCheckout: Open the cart or payment page first.
capReached: Stopped after the maximum number of tries.
diagnoseNotice: The snapshot is copied on this device and sent nowhere.
loginRequired: This site needs you to log in before coupons can be applied. Log in, then try again.
rateLimited: The site is limiting coupon attempts. Stopped to avoid problems; try again later.
originListed: Listed by the site for your cart
skippedIneligible: Skipped, the site says not applicable: {codes}
couponNotApplied: The best coupon ({code}) is not applied right now. Enter it yourself to get this saving.
preAppliedLost: A coupon that was already applied was removed during the search. Re-apply it if you still want it.
couldNotRestore: Could not remove the last coupon tried. Check your cart total before paying.
noOffers: No instant bank offers found on this page.
payHint: Next: open the payment page and click Promo-Flow again to see the best bank offer.
